conviction_note: Q3 numbers are new: no vinstvarning and no trading update, only 2028 targets and no annual guide. So abs_move sits near the name's own report-day moves (-8.2, -3.4, -6.6, -2.5, +6.2), trimmed toward the 'no guidance change' base. p_up 45 is a mild negative lean: the only independent series (Svensk Handel's Q3 online nicotine category, -9% y/y) points against Core, and adjusted EBIT missed consensus in Q1 and Q2. already_public.what: Report date and time confirmed: Q3 2026 report published 07:45 CET on 6 Nov, webcast 09:00 CET. No profit warning or trading update was filed after the Q2 report.
Company-commissioned Modular Finance consensus for Q3 2026, 3 contributors: net sales 1,212 MSEK (+27.27%), gross profit 234 (19.30%), adjusted EBIT 30 (2.47%), EPS 0.40 SEK

Q2 report guide: G&A to stabilise in absolute terms for the rest of 2026, with topline and gross profit growth gradually reducing the margin drag. 2028 targets reiterated (sales CAGR 18-25%, adjusted EBIT margin 5.5% +/-150bp). No annual guidance.
Svensk Handel E-handelsindikatorn: Swedish online nicotine and tobacco turnover -9% y/y in Q3 2026 (+6% Jan-Sep). Haypp republished it in English.
SEK 400m Danske Bank revolving credit facility replaces the ~SEK 170m overdraft
Snusnetto.se closed after the parcel-locker age-verification ruling; company says no material financial impact

new_in_release.expect: Net sales close to the 1,212 bar. Growth segment strong on an easy comp (Zyn was missing from Haypp US in Jul-Aug 2025) and Core at risk of slowing (Svensk Handel Q3 -9%). Slight miss or in line on sales; adjusted EBIT at or slightly below 30 MSEK, given the record of margin misses.
No annual guide is given. Most likely the 2028 targets are reiterated, plus commentary on G&A stabilising. A change is unlikely.
unknown. Q2 net debt rose to 221.6 MSEK from 40.1 and cash fell to 16.4 MSEK on working capital. Further growth in receivables is plausible and would weigh.
Q4 commentary may cover the parcel-locker verification change in Sweden and PMI's move of ZYN to 20-pouch cans. Mildly negative or neutral.

findings.finding: Svensk Handel's E-handelsindikatorn has Swedish online nicotine and tobacco turnover down 9% y/y in Q3 2026, after +19% in Q2. In Q2 the series tracked Haypp's Core segment (+18.2% reported, +15.8% organic) closely. Core is about 70% of group sales, so the series points to a sharp Core slowdown that a +27% consensus may not reflect. The company's own 26 Oct comment cited only Q1 and Q2 as confirmation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 sales landed on consensus (1,176.7 vs 1,177) and the stock rose 6.2% on 2026-08-13. Q1 2026 beat on sales (1,104 vs 1,084) and fell 2.5% on the EBIT miss. A sales miss driven by Core has no recent precedent.
findings.original_quote: Under tredje kvartalet minskade omsättningen i kategorin med 9 procent jämfört med motsvarande kvartal 2025. [The category's turnover fell 9% in Q3 versus Q3 2025.] Method note: 'Omsättningen ... är en skattning ... utifrån de uppgifter som den svenska allmänheten anger i undersökningen ... osäkerheten på varukategorinivå är något större' [turnover is a survey estimate (Novus panel, 2,076 interviews in September); uncertainty is somewhat larger at category level]. Haypp's quote: 'Omsättningstillväxten bekräftas även av den utveckling vi har sett hos Haypp under första och andra kvartalet.'
findings.why_not_priced: Haypp framed the release as positive ('continue to grow faster than e-commerce overall', the year-to-date +6%) and the stock rose 1.6% the next session (171.0 to 173.8 on 2026-10-27). Consensus was revised up after it, not down: adjusted EBIT 25.7 on 8 Oct to 30 on 3 Nov, sales 1,212 (+27%). If the market had priced a Core slowdown, consensus sales would have been trimmed and the October run-up of about 15% would have reversed on 26-27 Oct. It is a survey proxy covering Sweden only (Norway is also Core), so it is sized small.
findings.independence: none. It is the only independent series for Core. The Q2 tracking comes from Haypp's own Q2 report (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a0eab4fdaf741d3424e36ae1975a4b15c) and the Q2 indicator release (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bfdf9743c8bf2ec4de15d9b7b847cdbee&lang=en&src=listed).

findings.finding: Adjusted EBIT has missed company-compiled consensus in both 2026 quarters: Q1 about 27.2 MSEK vs 36 (-24%), Q2 28.6 vs 30 (-5%). The Q3 bar of 30 MSEK (2.47%) sits above Q2's actual margin of 2.4%, with July seasonality and continued US/UK marketing still in the period.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 EBIT miss: -2.5% on 2026-05-07. Q2 2026 small EBIT miss with EPS 0.00 vs 0.44: +6.2% on 2026-08-13 (the miss was forgiven on growth). Q4 2025: -6.6% on 2026-02-13. Q3 2025: -3.4%.
findings.source_date: 2026-05-04 (Q1 consensus); 2026-08-07 (Q2 consensus, https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/modular-finance-ir-consensus-haypp-group-consensus-estimates-q2-2026); actuals from the Q2 report 2026-08-12
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus adjusted EBIT rose from 25.7 (DB citing consensus, 8 Oct) to 30 (3 Nov), so the bar moved up into the print rather than baking in the miss pattern. This is an inference from the name's own record, not a fact about Q3, and is sized small.
findings.independence: Deutsche Bank's 8 Oct preview expected adjusted EBIT of 26.6 MSEK and a 2.2% margin, below today's 30 bar: https://www.placera.se/telegram/haypp-group-deutsche-bank-hojer-riktkursen-for-haypp--kop-upprepas-20261008

findings.finding: Management guided in the Q2 report that G&A stabilises in absolute terms through the rest of 2026, with gross profit growth reducing the margin drag. That supports a q/q margin step-up and is the main counterweight to finding 2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide was given at Q2 (stock +6.2% on 2026-08-13) and has not yet been tested by a print.
findings.original_quote: Koncernen förväntar sig att de allmänna administrationskostnaderna stabiliseras i absoluta tal under återstående delen av 2026 [The Group expects G&A costs to stabilise in absolute terms during the rest of 2026]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The consensus of 30 MSEK already sits above Q2's 28.6, so the guide is inside the bar and sized near zero. The residual is the chance the step-up exceeds a consensus margin that is only flat (2.47% vs 2.4%).
findings.independence: English version of the same report: https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a0eab4fdaf741d3424e36ae1975a4b15c (same document)

findings.finding: FX moved from a headwind in Q2 to a tailwind in Q3 for reported SEK sales. Average USD/SEK was +1.5% y/y and GBP/SEK +1.2% in Q3 2026, against -3.1% and -2.6% in Q2. NOK/SEK was +7.8% y/y (Q2 +5.8%). That adds roughly 1-2pp to reported growth over the organic rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 the FX contribution to Core was +16.7 MSEK (Q2 report); the stock did not react to FX specifically.
findings.source_date: 2026-11-05 (series fetched; quarterly averages computed from daily closes, GBPSEK=X and NOKSEK=X from the same endpoint)
findings.why_not_priced: Three-contributor consensus probably models FX, so this is mostly priced. It is a mechanical translation effect and sized small; it only matters against a reported-sales bar of +27.3%.

findings.finding: Counterparty: PMI's Q3 2026 10-Q/8-K shows US ZYN shipments +4.2% to 3.2bn pouches. FDA authorised 11 ZYN Ultra variants on 21 Aug 2026. PMI plans to move most flagship ZYN to 20-pouch cans. The US supply market Haypp's Growth segment sells into is steady but not booming; Haypp's US growth comes from share and the easy comp.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Zyn US resumption announcement (2025-09-04) moved the stock +11.8% the next day, so US Zyn news moves this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Public US filing, widely read, so mostly priced. The small positive is that supply and new SKUs were available all quarter, against a Q3 2025 when Haypp US had no Zyn until September (Q3 2025 report, https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b6829b1c8a4c13bc72f3e9b4ef40d56ce&lang=en&src=listed).
findings.independence: NACS coverage of the same results: https://www.convenience.org/stay-current/news/2026/october/26/pmi-sees-another-strong-quarter-from-smokeless

findings.finding: The balance sheet tightened in Q2: net debt 221.6 MSEK (40.1 at end-Q1), cash 16.4 MSEK, H1 operating cash flow 54.9 MSEK (137.1) on a working-capital build in receivables. A SEK 400m RCF followed on 24 Aug. Q3 cash flow and net debt are new in this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 net-debt jump was reported on 2026-08-12 and the stock rose 6.2%; the refinancing release on 2026-08-24 drew no visible reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Asked what the money buys: it funds working capital for a ramp (receivables, US/UK growth, orders +24% in Q2). The company says borrowings will not exceed existing debt, so the facility itself is not a distress sign and the sign is only mildly negative. The risk is a second quarter of working-capital outflow showing up in free cash flow, which a consensus of sales, margin and EPS does not carry.

findings.finding: On 19 Oct the Supreme Administrative Court refused leave to appeal, so geo-located BankID at parcel-locker pickup no longer satisfies age verification in Sweden. Haypp closed snusnetto.se and is rolling out a new locker verification across its Swedish sites in October, which is possible Q4 conversion friction for management to address in its outlook commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the ruling day the stock fell 2.3% (162.8 to 159.0 on 2026-10-19), then rose 2.1% the next day.
findings.original_quote: Beslutet förväntas inte ha någon väsentlig påverkan på Haypp Groups finansiella resultat. [The decision is not expected to have any material impact on Haypp Group's financial results.] (from the English twin release; the Swedish original is at the URL)
findings.why_not_priced: The company called it immaterial and the stock recovered within a day. It is only live if Q4 commentary mentions friction, so it is sized near zero.

outside_window.finding: PMI's transition of flagship ZYN to 20-pouch cans could cut US revenue per pouch for retailers including Haypp, with possible gross-margin effects from Q4 2026 or 2027

baseline_tension: Mild tension. The findings lean negative while the 20-day run-up is +6.45% (and about +15% from the 5 Oct low) and the 5-day is -3.96%. The negative lean agrees with the small run-up-driven priced lean (-0.32), so it is partly the free control. The anchor is not covered, so there is no positioning to beat.
language_note: Svensk Handel's own Swedish report (via.tt.se PDF) carried the method note, a Novus web panel of 2,076 interviews with category-level uncertainty flagged as larger. That was needed to size the -9% Q3 figure as a noisy proxy. Haypp's English republication carries the -9% but not the caveat.
Finwire/Placera's Swedish telegram carried Deutsche Bank's 8 Oct Q3 numbers (sales 1,224, adjusted EBIT 26.6 vs consensus then 1,202 / 25.7), which no English source returned.
Otherwise the filings are bilingual and the English versions carry the same facts; the Swedish Q2 report only supplied the original wording of the G&A guide.
lessons_applied: Net of the rest of the company: the Svensk Handel finding covers Swedish Core only, against a Growth segment on an easy comp, so it moved from -1.2 to -1.0
Cash can outweigh the headline: the working-capital / net-debt finding moved from -0.3 to -0.5

Guidance reiterated or none (median 2.3%) against new numbers (7.4%): no guide is expected to change, so abs_move moved from 6.5 to 6.0, still above the base because turnover is thin and the name's own report-day moves run about 6%
A verified fact is not a predicted reaction (Q2's EBIT miss rallied 6%): p_up moved from 44 to 45
